title: ForgeMotion 3D Animation Editor
author: FilipeDM
selftext:
This tool allows you to animate parts of the character's body and export them as FBX.

[https://perchance.org/v3eavg06t6](https://perchance.org/v3eavg06t6)

comments.author: FilipeDM
comments.body:
https://preview.redd.it/32f5qpk2kajh1.png?width=888&format=png&auto=webp&s=3ae0023250d3b218ed553a6dd06437b8fdfd9b67

You select the part of the body you want to animate.

replies.author: FilipeDM
replies.body:
https://preview.redd.it/fwi2659okajh1.png?width=1017&format=png&auto=webp&s=34bc8b631912b9cd890241ed49f71dbb5c76e2f7

And use Keyframe to record the movements you created.

replies.author: FilipeDM
replies.body:
https://preview.redd.it/4dcuxxu9lajh1.png?width=480&format=png&auto=webp&s=09f0fd7bacbf3a07cc61b5244b453f1b7f6d87cc

After you finish animating all the objects, you simply export them all in a WinRAR archive.
